title: SOP 205.5.1 audit records — distinct from Policy 463.10
summary:
SOP 205.5.1 describes quarterly audits across the five ALPR platforms named in SOP 205 (Flock, Vigilant, BOSS, PIPS, NCRIC), including case-number and search-justification review, submitted to the Support Services Captain.

Policy 463.10 describes monthly audits of internal users addressed to the Chief — a different recipient, scope, and set of criteria.

This request asks for SOP 205.5.1 records covering 2019-10-25 (the earliest version of SOP 205 that mandated quarterly operator audits) through the date of production.

policy_promises.quote: quarterly operator audits of all ALPR platforms... submitted to the Support Services Captain
policy_promises.tests: What SOP 205.5.1 audit records exist across the period the SOP has been in force?

prior_pra_refs.note: W012160 asked for SOP 205 audits 2020-2025 and received 'no responsive records.' This request re-asks under the SOP 205.5.1 framing specifically.
W012461 produced Policy 463.10 audit memos and 'no additional records' for SOP 205.5.1. This request isolates SOP 205.5.1.
W012160 answered 'no responsive records' for quarterly end-user/operator audits (Feb 2026). This request produced four 2021 quarterly end-user audit memos (May 2026).
W012320's responses repeated 'no responsive records' for search-activity audit records (Mar–May 2026). The four 2021 quarterly audits produced here are search-activity audits of that description.

W012461 Item 4 returned 'no responsive records' for SOP 205.5.1-model audits (Apr 2026). The 2021 quarterly memos produced here are SOP 205.5.1 end-user audits submitted to the Support Services Captain.

filed_because: SOP 205.5.1 and Policy 463.10 describe different audits (different recipients, scope, and criteria). This request covers SOP 205.5.1 records specifically.
notes:
The all-five-platform scope (Flock, Vigilant, BOSS, PIPS, NCRIC) covers platforms even if they are no longer actively used by SMPD, since data and user accounts may persist.

Response received 2026-05-14 (Juliana Santiago, Management Analyst, SMPD). Closed same day.
